title: Parks and Horticulture Authority Amendment Act 2015

sections.shortTitle: Parks and Horticulture Authority Amendment Act 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2015
ACT
IV OF 2015
PARKS
AND HORTICULTURE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An
Act to amend the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012
[Gazette
of Punjab Extraordinary
24th February, 2015]
No. PAP/Legis-2(51)/2014/1182, dated
24-2-2015.---The Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Bill,
2015, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on February
19, 2015 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on February 23, 2015, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Parks and Horticulture Authority Act, 2012 (XLVII
of 2012) for purposes hereinafter appearing:
It is enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be cited as the Parks and Horticulture Authority (Amendment) Act,
2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
